title: DNA Extraction from Fluids
author: Julie Huber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k2ccyaw
materials: Picogreen to determine concentration of DNA.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and clean workspace
steps.instruction: Wipe the bench, pipettes and racks with Nucleo‑clean and 70 % ethanol. Autoclave Swinnex 25 mm filter holders and prepare sterile 1× PBS. Make all buffers and enzyme stocks as listed, filter‑sterilize where indicated, and store aliquots at the prescribed temperatures.

substeps.instruction: 1M Tris‑HCl (100 mL, pH 8.0): dissolve 15.76 g Tris‑HCl in 80 mL MilliQ H₂O, adjust pH with 10 M NaOH, bring to 100 mL, autoclave.
1M NaH₂PO₄·H₂O (100 mL, pH 8.0): dissolve 13.799 g NaH₂PO₄·H₂O in 80 mL MilliQ H₂O, adjust pH with 10 M NaOH, bring to 100 mL, low‑heat dissolve, autoclave.
TE buffer (50 mL, 0.01 M Tris, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0): mix 0.5 mL 1 M Tris, 0.1 mL 0.5 M EDTA, 49.4 mL MilliQ H₂O, filter‑sterilize.
10 M NaOH (100 mL): dissolve 40 g NaOH in 90 mL MilliQ H₂O, bring to 100 mL, store in plastic.
20 % SDS (100 mL): dissolve 20 g SDS with low heat, filter‑sterilize, do NOT autoclave.
5 M NaCl (100 mL): dissolve 29.22 g NaCl in 100 mL MilliQ H₂O, autoclave.
0.5 M Na₂EDTA (100 mL, pH 8.0): dissolve 18.61 g Na₂EDTA in 80 mL MilliQ H₂O, add ~2 g NaOH pellets, adjust pH with 10 M NaOH, bring to 100 mL, autoclave.
5 % CTAB (100 mL): dissolve 5 g CTAB in 100 mL MilliQ H₂O with low heat, autoclave.
Proteinase K (10 mg mL⁻¹): add 6 mL MilliQ H₂O to 0.06 g lyophilized enzyme, aliquot and store at –20 °C.
Lysozyme (50 mg mL⁻¹): add 20 mL MilliQ H₂O to 1 g lyophilized enzyme, aliquot and store at –20 °C.

DNA Extraction Buffer (50 mL, 100 mM Tris, 100 mM EDTA, 100 mM NaH₂PO₄, 1.5 M NaCl, 1 % CTAB): combine 5 mL 1 M Tris, 10 mL 0.5 M EDTA, 5 mL 1 M NaH₂PO₄, 15 mL 5 M NaCl, 10 mL 5 % CTAB, 5 mL MilliQ H₂O; filter‑sterilize.

steps.title: Cut filter into small pieces
steps.instruction: Using a sterile piece of foil, a clean razor blade (autoclaved and ethanol‑flamed) and ethanol‑flamed forceps, cut the filter into small fragments. For a Sterivex cartridge, flame‑sterilize pliers, crack the cartridge, remove the filter with the razor blade, and cut it into 6–8 pieces. Save any remaining half‑filter in RNAlater as described.

steps.title: Rinse filter and add DEB
steps.instruction: Place the cut filter into a new 50 mL tube containing 10 mL autoclaved, 0.2 µm‑filtered 1× PBS. Rinse the filter with forceps, transfer it to a clean 2 mL tube, add 1 mL DNA Extraction Buffer (DEB), and keep the tube on ice.

steps.title: Filter RNAlater and combine
steps.instruction: Pour the RNAlater from the 50 mL filter tube into the PBS rinse tube, then filter this mixture through a 25 mm 0.2 µm filter using a 60 mL syringe (if processing only half a filter, pour only half the RNAlater). Rinse the 0.2 µm filter with 10 mL 1× PBS and push air through to remove liquid. Cut the 25 mm filter into pieces and add them to the 2 mL tube already containing the filter fragments and DEB.

steps.title: Add enzymes and freeze‑thaw
steps.instruction: To the 2 mL tube add 20 µL Proteinase K (10 mg mL⁻¹) and 40 µL Lysozyme (50 mg mL⁻¹). Freeze the tube at –80 °C for 15 min, then thaw at 37 °C for 5 min; repeat this freeze‑thaw cycle three times (the tube may be left frozen at –80 °C until the next day if desired).

steps.title: 37 °C enzymatic incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 30 min at 37 °C in a water bath.

steps.title: Add SDS and heat incubation
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL filter‑sterilized 20 % SDS solution to each 2 mL tube, invert several times to mix, then incubate for 2 h at 65 °C in a water bath.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Working in a fume hood, fill each tube to the level of the cap with phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, pH 8.0), vortex, and centrifuge at 3000 rpm for 5 min. Transfer the upper aqueous layer to a new 2 mL tube and repeat the extraction once more (total of two washes).

steps.title: Isopropanol DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Estimate the aqueous volume from the hash marks on the tube wall, add 0.6 × that volume of room‑temperature 100 % isopropanol, swirl or invert gently to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 2 h to overnight in the dark.

steps.title: Pellet wash and dry
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at top speed (≈13 000 rpm) for 30 min. Carefully discard the supernatant (checking that the pellet remains). Add 1 mL 70 % ethanol, invert several times, and centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 10 min. Discard the ethanol and repeat the wash once more (total of two ethanol washes). Dry the pellet in a SpeedVac for ~15 min, flicking the tube to ensure complete dryness; note that pellets may detach from the tube walls after the second wash.

steps.title: Elute DNA from pellet
steps.instruction: Add 90–250 µL nuclease‑free sterile water or 1× TE buffer to the dried pellet, flick and shake the tube to resuspend all DNA, and let the pellet dissolve for 1–2 h in a refrigerator.

steps.title: Prepare stocks and store DNA
steps.instruction: Aliquot the eluate into working and archive stocks and store the working stocks at –20 °C and the archive stocks at –80 °C.
